name: @arena/body-ui
description: The reusable view model for Arena body surfaces (Work Order B010; issue #82): pure, deterministic, frozen-data-driven projections of canonical agent-body/certification reads into the shapes the Body Studio renders — the Body Version identity card (content-addressed, immutable, explicit versioning), the Possession matrix rows (Body × Substrate × runtime/environment × policy as a VERSIONED COMPOSITION BINDING — never 'the body runs model X'), the skill/knowledge/tool composition listings, the certification claim cards (a claim applies to the tested composition, never the bare model) and the composition-scoped substrate comparison model (compare full compositions under identical suite/environment semantics; a bare substrate/model ranking request is a TYPED REJECTION). Zero new external dependencies: the package depends only on the @arena/read-model contract types and adds no runtime authority — it is a projection, never a second domain model.
